correctness.rationale: For the 12-vertex 30-edge icosahedral poles-and-rings model, parity-facet lemma yields six exact integer stages and no noninteger changes. r1 graph cycle rank 30−12+1=19; r2 full 446-face nerve f=(12,60,140,150,72,12); r3 2037-face nerve f=(12,66,220,465,612,452,180,30). I independently fetched MORSE_CERTIFICATE.json Git blob 53a1e9ed4bf20d8094136c24271ddeabf080ef7a and checked every pair, partition, every oriented Hasse cover and full acyclicity: r2 222 matched pairs, 1 critical vertex and 1 critical 2-cell, 1572 Hasse covers and 446 visited; r3 1013 pairs, 1 critical vertex and 10 critical 4-cells, 9924 covers and 2037 visited. Thus integral homotopy S2 and wedge10 S4 by Forman; independent raw GF2 ranks agree but do not establish integral result alone. Unique antipodes prove S10 at r4 and contractibility r5. Consecutive nonzero degrees disjoint, giving claimed integral barcode.

Nontrivial exhaustive Morse certificate lends mathematical assurance without being the reason for value by itself.
